_comment: 形态轨道（track）—— 只放「形态规格」，不放任何视觉风格、不放叙事口径。视觉见 looks.json，叙事见 narratives.json。改这里即改所有下游菜单/校验/默认规格。

3d_manhua.label: 3D 漫剧
3d_manhua.desc: 3D 渲染 + 漫剧分镜语言。资产最重（角色三视图 + 场景辅卡），首帧强制且角度必须匹配。

guoman-3d-render.label: 国漫 3D 渲染流（默认）
guoman-3d-render.prompt: 3D rendered, Chinese-animation manhua-cel look, clean dark outlines on top of 3D shading, soft PBR materials with non-photoreal finish, dynamic manhua panel composition, dramatic cinematic light, webtoon-friendly vertical framing

pixar-disney.label: 皮克斯 Disney 流
pixar-disney.prompt: 3D rendered Pixar/Disney-style, rounded soft shapes, large expressive eyes, soft cinematic lighting, stylized non-photoreal materials, manhua panel composition with dynamic angles

semi-painterly-3d.label: 半厚涂 3D 写实流
semi-painterly-3d.prompt: 3D rendered with painterly thick-coating, semi-realistic proportions, PBR materials with brushstroke texture, dramatic cinematic light, manhua panel composition, webtoon-friendly framing

2d_animation.label: 2D 动画
2d_animation.desc: 2D 赛璐珞 / webtoon。资产最轻（角色卡 ×1、场景卡 ×1），首帧可选，逐镜分镜。

guoman-webtoon.label: 国漫 webtoon 流（默认）
guoman-webtoon.prompt: 2D cel-shaded animation, Chinese-animation webtoon style, clean bold black outlines, flat color fills with cel highlights

cel-anime.label: 日漫赛璐珞流
cel-anime.prompt: 2D cel-shaded anime, Japanese TV-anime cel style, soft cinematic lighting, clean dark line art, anime proportions, flat fills with subtle gradients, expressive anime micro-expressions

light-color-webtoon.label: 轻彩漫 webtoon 流
light-color-webtoon.prompt: 2D webtoon / manhua full-color style, flat color fills, minimal shading, panel-driven composition, bold line art, bright clean backgrounds, expressive reaction shots

live_action.label: 真人写实
live_action.desc: 摄影级真实感。角色卡 16:9 纯白（左脸特写 + 右三视图半身），场景卡绝对无人物。
